subject: Reminder: Complete your Annual Security Awareness Training by Nov 30
body:
Hello {{firstName}},
This is a friendly reminder that your Annual Security Awareness Training is due by November 30. All faculty, staff, and graduate assistants are required to complete the training each year to maintain access to university systems.
The training takes about 30 minutes and covers phishing recognition, data handling, and password hygiene. You can access it through the training dashboard in MyUSF:
Go to Training Dashboard
If you have already completed this year's training, please disregard this message. Questions can be directed to the OTS Help Desk at (813) 974-1234.
Thank you for doing your part to protect the USF community.
USF Office of Technology Services
